I farm here in Mwanza, and this small piece of land I am renting — less than a quarter hectare — I have planted with cassava and some sweet potato together. Since the land is not mine, I don't want to spend money on chemical fertilizer for root crops that don't really need it. I use local cuttings from last year's harvest like my neighbors do, and I will weed by hand with my family. Maybe I pay a few young men to help me clear and ridge the land at the start, but otherwise we manage ourselves.
